notes: Every write to Propago now has an on/off switch, on a Writes to Propago card at the top of each customer's Propago tab: accepting orders, shipments and closes, inventory, and catalog. They all start OFF, including for customers already linked, so after this update Amphora sends nothing to Propago until you switch it on. Turn them back on for any customer who is already live. Orders and new parts still come in from Propago, and work queued while a switch was off is sent once you turn it on.
